name: unfix
description: Jurgen Appelo's unFIX pattern library for organisation design: Bases, the seven Crew types, Forums, Captains, Chiefs, Chairs and the sixteen Role Attributes. Use for org structure, team topology, decision rights, reteaming, or naming the seats in an AI-agent organisation - including when the user says circles, squads, tribes, chapters, holacracy, sociocracy or Spotify model. Records what does not transfer to an agent org rather than papering over it.
